description: This file contains authentication utility functions for user sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth sign-in, sign-out, password update, error handling, and session retrieval, utilizing Supabase authentication client.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, with a redirect URL for email confirmation.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user using email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Triggers password reset flow by sending reset email.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in user via magic link (OTP email).

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Initiates OAuth sign-in with specified provider.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors with user feedback and redirection.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's data.
